name: Glyph Bot
promise: One harness that builds, runs and watches your agents, with your whole vault behind them.

name: Glyph Jot
promise: Dictation that types anywhere on your Mac and iPhone, meetings recorded and transcribed, every word kept in a vault you own. Unlimited, and free.

name: Glyph Cast
promise: Screen videos, cleaned up: record your screen, get a clean MP4 with the voice cleaned, ums cut, framed and zoomed.

name: Glyph Time
promise: See where your hours go: a quiet count-up on the edge of your screen, a nudge every 30 minutes, every session saved to your vault.

name: Glyph Ibis
promise: Fifty live sources of outside knowledge, refreshed daily into your vault, so your agents know today instead of their training cutoff.

name: Glyph Rig
promise: A harness over your harnesses. Names, connects and runs agents across every Mac you own.

name: Glyph Arena
promise: Runs the same job across every model and recipe, scored on your own work, and tells you which one actually won.

name: Glyph Well
promise: Say how you slept, ate and felt; it reads the patterns, holds your results and comes to the appointment with you.

name: Glyph Wealth
promise: Accounts, spending, holdings and net worth, read from what you say and what your statements show. It never invents a number.

name: Glyph CRM
promise: Everyone and everything you deal with, kept as notes in your vault, so every other Glyph app knows who you mean.

name: Glyph Omega
promise: Your mission, your vision and your goals, broken down until what is left is the thing to do next.

name: Glyph Connect
promise: Every app and tool your agents can get at, what each one may read and write, and what is not connected yet.

name: Glyph Life
promise: Policies, subscriptions, documents and renewals, each one watched, so the first you hear of a lapse is not the lapse.
